scenario: An on-delay is a `where` condition on `dwell` (LCDB.3.2.3): the rule fires on the first tick at which the Motion fact has been in working memory for 2_s, once. Drives the time-dependent test CE that `dwell` lowers to, re-evaluated on each pump's tick (LTIM.2.4.2), and edge-once firing (LTIM.2.5.1). Pin: set 0; assert Motion; pump (0 s); advance 1_s, pump (1 s, no fire); advance 1_s, pump (2 s, fires); advance 5_s, pump (no second fire). Messages are ['settled']. `ts` equals the entry time, so the vector holds whichever of the two `dwell` readings the runtime implements.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    zone: String key
    ts: Time

rule settled:
    Motion m where m.dwell >= 2_s
->
    log critical "settled"
